caseScope.scenarioId: Stable replay scenario or equivalent scenario identifier.
caseScope.provider: Provider identifier or redacted equivalent when applicable.
caseScope.corridor: Corridor identifier or redacted equivalent when applicable.
caseScope.product: Product identifier or redacted equivalent when applicable.

immutability.caseBecomesImmutableWhen: After redaction, evidence collection, frozen normalized input hashing, engine replay capture, and independent human-steward review are complete.
immutability.corrections: Do not rewrite frozen cases. Add a new case version or correction record that references the original case ID and explains the change.

validationRules: deterministicReplay.inputHash must match the redacted frozen normalized input
humanReview.status must equal approved for denominator eligibility
engine abstentions and human inconclusive reviews are excluded from agreement denominator
false-available and false-unavailable results are counted separately
